label: pp-meeting-notes-decoder
topic: Decoding the meeting notes: what each cryptic line most plausibly means
summary: Eight fragments (BRIEF-2026-11-12.md lines 55-69) decoded. Most plausible readings: Formlabs = a shortlist of ~10 printable resins from a 72-material catalogue; woolly mammoth = Colossal Biosciences (no public 'mammoth' AI travel product found, so the link is undetermined); Anthropic = likely the AI for Science API-credit program (up to $20,000 / 6 months, so '3 million tokens' is not that figure); Mamou-Mani = bioplastic-pellet printing practice, no Formlabs link found; .life already carries genome edit list + staged cell geometry/mechanics/lineage but has NO vocabulary at all for locomotion, sensors, actuation or light; Levin 'optogenetic xenobots' has no located paper, only EosFP light-memory xenobots and a stated 'next step' for light-evoked behaviour in neurobots. No source for 'license your patent', '500 papers', 'non profit Bioelectricity' or '3 million tokens' was found.
lay_summary: The notes are shorthand from a meeting, a bit like a shopping list written in a hurry. We matched each line to public facts and to the team's own file format. Some lines have an obvious reading, like Formlabs being a maker of resin 3D printers. Others, like the woolly mammoth line, could mean several things and we did not guess. The team's file format can describe a creature's DNA and how its cells change over time, but it has no way yet to say 'this cell senses light and so the body moves'. That is like having a recipe book with ingredients and photos but no step that says 'when the oven beeps, take it out'.

recommendations: Ask the note-taker one question per fragment (in table) before building on any reading.

To support light-triggered movement .life would need: a sensor/actuator block, a stimulus time series with sub-second units, a behaviour/kinematics channel with provenance kinds, and a link to a simulator, none of which exist at present.
Treat 'license your patent', '500 papers', 'non profit Bioelectricity', '3 million tokens' as unsourced until a speaker is identified.
